decision: Xoa 21 component khong ai nhap TRUOC, roi chi chuan hoa phan con lai, thay vi va mau/ban kinh/chuoi cho ca 12 file nhu ke hoach mac dinh
impact: Tiet kiem ~22 chuoi va 5 file se bi xoa o Phase 7, va bo open-in-chat ma register cam. Doi lai moi ban va cuc bo trong 21 file bien mat; phase sau keo tung component ve phai va lai tu dau theo nghi thuc AC-8

decision: Lop chuyen kieu o packages/ui; hinh dang TranscriptItem/Tone/Source chuyen xuong packages/validation/src/agent-transcript.ts
impact: Khong goi nao nhan them phu thuoc: ai chi o packages/ui la noi da khai no, hinh dang cat bien chi can zod. Loai phuong an dat ca hai o packages/validation (keo ai vao goi ma apps/api va apps/agent cung dung) va phuong an de nguyen o apps/app (packages/ui khong nhap duoc tu apps/app)

decision: Nhanh nen la origin/docs/luat-chat-ai-elements chu khong phai onehub
impact: docs/chat-ui.md va ke hoach chuyen chua merge vao onehub; lay onehub lam nen thi vong nay code theo mot luat khong ton tai o nhanh dich. Doi lai PR cua vong nay xep chong len PR luat va phai cho no merge truoc
revisit: khi PR luat merge vao onehub thi rebase ve onehub

decision: Keo Phase 8 (rang chong tai phat) len vong nay thanh AC-9 va AC-10, thay vi de o cuoi ke hoach
impact: Vong nay vua don 21 file; khong co rang thi cay day lai dung cach cu — chinh ke hoach noi do la cach 20 file tich tu lan dau. Doi lai vong nay to hon Phase 0 nguyen ban, va them hai tac vu cong phai khai o .githooks/gate-shape.json neu chung vao bo cong day

decision: bo design-pass — be mat doi la chuoi trong hai component da ton tai, khong bo cuc moi, khong luong moi
impact: Cong 1 duyet UI bang chu — mat khoanh khac visual truoc duyet. Doi lai khong ton mot phien dung ban bam duoc cho 12 chuoi
revisit: Phase 1 thay xuong song transcript la cho design-pass thuc su co viec

decision: Khong dung lan design tinh cua kit (executors.design.ui_check / design.gate); AC-6 dung rang rieng nc_mau_ban_kinh
impact: Rang rieng do dung hai thu docs/design.md thuc su cam o kho nay — mau ngoai bang va ban kinh ngoai thang — chat hon mot bo quet chung. Doi lai gop Cong 2 khong co so cua lan design tinh; va bang tra cua kit goi khoa la executors.design.static trong khi config kho khai ui_check/gate, nen khoa khong khop bang

decision: B1 do VA va luon neu hoi quy, trong cung vong; phep do phai tu dung tren puppeteer-core
impact: Ban va di cung phep do sinh ra no, va nguong dat/khong thanh mot tieu chi that (AC-7). Doi lai vong nay ganh viec dung ha tang do tu khong — jsdom khong bo cuc nen khong do duoc content-visibility, va kho khong co Playwright hay Lighthouse

decision: Dinh nghia mo coi doi tu 'khong co cho nhap tu ngoai thu muc' sang KHA DAT BAC CAU tu tap duoc apps/** nhap; so tep xoa 21 -> 19, tap song la message/reasoning/shimmer/conversation
impact: Dinh nghia cu se xoa shimmer.tsx va lam reasoning.tsx vo ngay o bun run build, vi reasoning.tsx dong 14 nhap ./shimmer. Phat hien truoc khi code, con nguyen cua veto. Doi lai phep do phuc tap hon: phai dung do thi nhap chu khong dem duoc bang grep

decision: Chi chuyen Tone/Source/said/reasoned/did xuong packages/validation; dang 'asked' o lai apps/app va KHONG di qua lop chuyen kieu
impact: Dang 'asked' mang EveMessageInputRequest tu goi eve, ma eve chi la dep cua apps/app va apps/agent. Phan tich no o bien se phai doi kieu o agent-clarification-composer, agent-builder-chat va agent-panel — ba trong sau tep AC-2 cam cham. docs/chat-ui.md von da xep form hoi lai vao nhom giu shadcn, nen 'asked' khong thuoc phan AI Elements so huu. Doi lai lop chuyen chi phu ba dang, va AC-4 phai khang dinh tuong minh viec tu choi dang thu tu
revisit: Phase nao dua form hoi lai sang AI Elements thi mo lai — luc do se can phan tich EveMessageInputRequest o bien

decision: Dan so chuan hoa sua 8 -> 14 chuoi va 3 -> 4 ban kinh, sau khi ban CLI tuoi cua conversation ve cay va sau khi rang chu-cung duoc va de thay lop 'gia tri mac dinh cua tham so'
impact: Ban tuoi cua conversation tra hai chuoi ve dang chuoi cung (ban cu doc qua useMessages) va mang hai rounded-full thay vi mot. Phep dem dau tien cua toi dung regex tho nen sot 'of', 'attachment', va hai chuoi cua reasoning dong 125. So hien tai do chinh rang do. Doi lai hop dong da sua so lieu hai lan truoc khi ky — day la lop loi da co ba tien le trong kho

decision: AC-2 khai them packages/validation/test/** va bun.lock; AC-8 doi tu 'danh sach so dong' sang 'van tay cua phan lech'
impact: Rang pham vi do that tren chinh vong nay vi hai duong do thieu trong danh sach khai — ca hai la he qua tat yeu cua AC-4 va cua viec packages/ui nhan them mot phu thuoc noi bo, nen y dinh pham vi khong noi, chi danh sach khai thieu. Van tay thay so dong vi so dong la ho so gion: chen mot dong phia tren lam lech het, con thay mot dong bang dong khac thi so khong doi

decision: chu-cung.mjs dao khuon: tu 'liet ke tung hinh dang cu phap co chuoi hien thi' (danh sach den mo) sang 'quet MOI chuoi co chu roi tru di danh sach trang da khai' (danh sach trang dong), theo dung loi mau-ban-kinh.mjs. Dan so chuan hoa 14 -> 16 chuoi: message.tsx them 'Image' va 'Attachment'
impact: Khuon cu bo sot hai lan, moi lan mot hinh dang moi: gia tri mac dinh cua tham so (da va), roi bien trung gian (message.tsx:348 gan attachmentLabel roi render {attachmentLabel} o dong 392). Cung mot lop loi, nen chu kho quyet dinh doi khuon thay vi va lan thu ba. Khuon moi khong con phai biet chuoi di duong nao ra man: mac dinh la do, mien la ngoai le co ten. Danh sach trang co sau nhom theo vi tri (chi-thi, duong-nhap, kieu, lop-css, ten-devtools, loi-bat-bien) va 23 muc theo gia tri (bien-the, enum-may, ten-the, khoa-ky-thuat, gia-tri-css), moi muc mot ly do bang chu in ra trong thong diep cua rang. Chuoi trong thuoc tinh hien thi va chu giua the khong bao gio duoc mien theo gia tri. Cap hai chieu chay that tren ban sao cay: (a) chu giua the, (b) aria-label, (c) gia tri mac dinh, (d) bien trung gian deu ma 1 va neu nguyen van; hai doi chung am (e) variant='ghost'/size='icon-sm' va (f) className='text-balance' deu ma 0
